en.title: IRS launches new mobile app, expanding digital services for taxpayers
en.summary: The IRS today announced the launch of the new IRS mobile app, replacing IRS2Go and expanding the agency’s digital services to give taxpayers more ways to securely access IRS tools and account services from their mobile devices.

en.title: Treasury and IRS Move to Protect Health Care Benefits for Eligible Americans
en.summary: The U.S. Department of the Treasury and the Internal Revenue Service issued proposed regulations to implement President Trump’s Working Families Tax Cuts reforms to the Premium Tax Credit (PTC), a refundable tax credit that helps eligible American taxpayers afford health insurance purchased through the Health Insurance Exchanges.

en.title: IRS highlights partnership with UK tax authority’s new whistleblower program
en.summary: The Internal Revenue Service today highlighted its partnership with the United Kingdom’s whistleblower program, which drew upon the IRS Whistleblower Office’s expertise to quickly get established.

es.title: El IRS lanza nueva aplicación móvil y amplía servicios digitales para contribuyentes
es.summary: El IRS anunció hoy el lanzamiento de la nueva aplicación móvil IRS, la cual reemplaza a IRS2Go y amplía los servicios digitales de la agencia para ofrecer a los contribuyentes más formas de acceder de manera segura a las herramientas y servicios de cuenta del IRS desde sus dispositivos móviles.
